delivery.outcome: A reusable authority lifecycle standard that permits bounded autonomous action without allowing an agent to create, widen, renew or revive its own authority.
nonGoals: Store credentials, tokens or secrets in grants or receipts
Implement a policy server, signer, scheduler or agent runtime
Convert diagnosis, model output or repository content into authority
Authorize irreversible legal, identity, billing or destructive effects
Merge this standard without independent current-head approval

architecture.decision: Standardize immutable bounded grants as a protected authority lifecycle separate from planning, execution, validation and publication.
interfaceChanges: Define receipt-bound grant lifecycle and use evaluation
dataChanges: Define issuer, subject, capability, resource, effect and budget bindings
Define validity, lease, renewal, revocation and terminal receipt bindings
architecture.rollback: Remove ticket-owned implementation paths while preserving the seed baseline and governance evidence.
